translation: Pasa ⟨a través de⟩ tu tierra como ⟨el⟩ río ⟨Nilo⟩, ⟨hija⟩ de Tarshish: ⟨no⟩ ⟨hay⟩ ⟨cinturón⟩ ⟨ya⟩

tokens.meaning: to cross over; used very widely of any transition
the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally or figuratively)
Tarshish, a place on the Mediterranean, hence, the epithet of a merchant vessel
a nonentity; generally used as a negative particle
properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially
